resource_title: Cartografía de radios censales de Argentina corregidos, completados y estandarizados de 1991, 2001, 2010 y 2022
license_evidence: CONICET Digital record 11336/149711 states that, except where explicitly noted, the item is published under Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Unported (CC BY 2.5).
attribution: Rodriguez, Gonzalo Martin; Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas (CONICET), CEUR.
citation: Rodriguez, Gonzalo Martin; (2022): Cartografía de radios censales de Argentina corregidos, completados y estandarizados de 1991, 2001, 2010 y 2022. Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas. (dataset). http://hdl.handle.net/11336/149711
methodology: Curated longitudinal research cartography. The record describes backward harmonization using 2022 geometry as the basis for 2010, 2010 for 2001, and 2001 for 1991, together with corrections/completions, REDATAM-linkable code correction, and standardized unchanged boundaries.
record_notes: The current record says the 1991 and 2010 releases identify radios censused with the sampled extended questionnaire.
The current record says a future version, not V2025-1, is intended to add municipality, locality and agglomerate codes/names. No EPH agglomerate semantics are inferred from this source.
known_limitations: CEUR V2025-1 is curated research cartography and is not a mirror or byte-equivalent substitute for official INDEC Census 2010 cartography.
The dataset deliberately corrects, completes, aligns and standardizes census-radio geometry across vintages for research use.
Native schema and identifier authority must be characterized from this exact V2025-1 2010 file before normalization.
No INDEC-versus-CEUR preference or winner policy is implied by adopting this source as an independent geography authority.
V2025-1 does not itself establish EPH radio-to-agglomerate membership; A7 must inspect official INDEC EPH authority separately.
